lines.text: The sons of Korah sing of God's lovely dwelling place, and the singer's soul longs for the courts of the LORD.
The sparrow finds a home and the swallow a nest, where she places her young near God's altars.
Pilgrims pass through the Valley of Elah and make it a place of springs, going from strength to strength until each appears in Zion.
The singer prays to the God of Isaac and asks God to look with favor on His anointed.
The singer says one day in God's courts is better than a thousand elsewhere, and he would rather be a doorkeeper there.
